title: Sommerfeld-enhanced annihilation and the CMB, dwarf-spheroidal and antiproton constraints on the electroweak multiplets that fit the LZ event
question: Are the TeV electroweak multiplets (2,1/2),(3,1),(4,3/2),(5,2) that fit the LZ event as inelastic DM (P037) excluded by Planck, Fermi dwarfs, H.E.S.S. and AMS-02 once the Sommerfeld enhancement is computed with the full coupled-channel potential?
headline_result: Coupled-channel Sommerfeld factor S = 1.66 for the 1 TeV Higgsino (no resonance below 7 TeV) leaves it 0.16-0.8 below all recalled limits; the (3,1),(4,3/2),(5,2) multiplets fitting LZ at 1 TeV have S = 5/88/137 on ZZ-dominated tree rates and are excluded by x4.7-23, x36-1800, x166-8300 (Planck alone x36, x166 for Y>=3/2); thermal under-abundance rescues only a <=20% Y=1 triplet at delta ~364 keV
model_or_mechanism: SU(2)xU(1) fermion n-plets Y=(n-1)/2, neutral Majorana state; s-wave annihilation via t/u-channel gauge diagrams; multi-channel Sommerfeld (W Yukawa off-diagonal, Z Yukawa + Coulomb diagonal, one-loop splitting thresholds); line from charged components
builds_on: LZ arXiv:2609.02823; P037, P007, P054; competes with P025
agent_tools: Read x11, Bash x11, Write x6, Edit x12, Skill x1 (dataviz)
software_and_packages: python 3.12.13; numpy 2.5.3 (linalg.solve); scipy 1.18.1 (integrate.solve_ivp DOP853, complex); pandas 3.0.5; matplotlib 3.11.2 (Agg); hand derivations
local_inputs: PAPER_GUIDE; papers P025/P037/P007/P054; work/P025/details.md; work/P037/details.md (grep); results_ledger.csv; ENVIRONMENT_versions.txt; dataviz palette.md
recalled_knowledge: 23: EW constants, positronium normalisation, wino tree rate and Hisano matrices, CFS splitting formula, wino resonance 2.3-2.5 TeV, Hulthen form, Slatyer inelastic criterion, thermal masses (Y>=1 uncertain), Planck p_ann and f_eff, Fermi/HESS/AMS/line anchors (uncertain), freeze-out scaling
